This is an opportunity to work on high-impact, workflow-heavy products where thoughtful technical decisions can improve care-team efficiency, member experience, and Hinge Health’s ability to deliver care at scale.
  
  
This is a hands-on Staff Engineer role. You will write production code, lead architecture and design reviews, participate in operational response, and coach engineers toward stronger technical ownership.

* Deliver large projects that introduce new product capabilities, often acting as a maintainer for key code repositories.

**This is a Bengaluru-based role**
that involves regular interaction and collaboration with Hinge Health colleagues in San Francisco, CA.
  
  

* Time zones: San Francisco is in the Pacific Time Zone, which is 12 hours and 30 minutes behind India Standard Time (e.g., 8am in San Francisco is 8:30pm in Bengaluru).
* Hours: Applicants should be open to meetings in the late evening following India Standard Time to align with San Francisco working hours (8am - 6pm PT).

* Bachelor’s Degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Engineering or related technical field
* 10+ years of non-internship full time professional software development experience
* 4+ years of experience with at least one software programming language
* 4+ years of experience in the full software development life cycle
* 3+ years of work experience with react JS and Node JS/ Typescript
* 1+ years of experience in mentoring and leading junior team members, collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams, and contributing to project planning and decision-making
* Experience with using AI tools such as Github copilot, Cursor, LangChain, LangGraph
* Experience delivering large software projects or features in a production environment.
* Proficiency in at least one modern programming language (e.g., Python, Java, JavaScript, etc.).

**Preferred Qualifications**

* A platform-as-product mindset: understanding internal users and consumers, defining clear contracts, improving developer experience and adoption, and measuring platform outcomes.
* Strong backend and distributed-systems fundamentals, including latency, throughput, availability, capacity, backpressure, consistency, resilience, and failure-mode analysis.
* Experience integrating large language models or generative AI services into production workflows with appropriate evals, validation, observability, and failure handling.
* Experience defining and maintaining SLOs and SLAs, using error budgets, service-health metrics, alerting, on-call practices, incident response, and root-cause analysis to improve reliability.

* Experience with headless CMS integrations, webhook-driven systems, vendor adapters, content delivery networks, or publishing pipelines.

description:
TechGrove is the
**Centre of Excellence**
for Banyan Software, based in Chennai, India. It plays a key role in supporting Banyan’s global businesses through technology, security, and software development. TechGrove brings together India’s deep pool of technical talent with Banyan’s long-term approach to growth, creating a trusted, developer-focused environment where people can do their best work.

About the role
  
HWA International builds the trust accounting software that bank trust departments, credit unions,
  
foundations, and family offices run their fiduciary operations on. We are an AI-first engineering
  
organization, and agentic coding tools are how we build. Our platform is in a significant modernization,
  
and this role is one of the engineers who builds it.
  
Agentic tooling lets us understand existing behavior and specify what comes next far faster than that
  
work could be done by hand. You will use it to do exactly that, then build the modern platform end to
  
end: the C# and .NET services, the web front end, and the AWS infrastructure they run on. This is a full-
  
stack role, and you own the infrastructure your work runs on.
  
Accounting accuracy is the product, so correctness is the bar. Anything new has to produce the same
  
results as what it replaces, or better, and proving that is part of the job.
  
You will work within an architecture set by engineering leadership, with real influence on it. We work to
  
modern engineering standards: trunk-based development on GitHub, continuous integration,
  
infrastructure as code, and feature flags.
  
What you will do
  
• Build the modern platform across the stack. Write features, services, and fixes in C# and .NET,
  
and the web front end that sits on them, against the architecture and patterns the team has set.
  
• Own the infrastructure for what you deliver. Within the cloud architecture engineering
  
leadership sets, define and maintain your AWS environments as code, along with the
  
networking, managed databases, and services behind them, so every environment is
  
reproducible and version controlled.
  
• Own delivery and observability. Build and run the CI/CD pipelines, staged rollout, and feature
  
flags that take your work to production, and the monitoring, logging, and alerting that tell us
  
how it behaves there.
  
• Work out what existing code does and write it down. Use agentic tooling to analyze established
  
application and database logic, then produce a clear written specification of the behavior that
  
has to be preserved.
  
• Move business logic into application code and prove it matches. Relocate rules wherever they
  
live today, including inside the database, into maintainable, tested application code. Build the
  
data migration paths and test harnesses that show the modern platform's calculations match
  
the existing ones.

• Verify what the tools give you. Agentic tooling drafts the analysis, the documentation, and
  
much of the code. An agent's account of what existing code does is a hypothesis until you have
  
read the code and confirmed it. Characterization tests come before behavior changes.
  
• Own the work in production. Whatever ships under your name is yours, from the first analysis
  
through to how it behaves in production. Take part in incident response, communicate clearly
  
while an issue is open, and follow through to root cause and a durable fix.
  
What we are looking for
  
You do not need to be an expert in every layer. Agentic tools let one strong engineer work across the full
  
stack and the infrastructure under it, so we look for depth where judgment matters most, enough
  
working knowledge everywhere else to direct the tools and catch their mistakes, and fluency with the
  
tools from day one.
  
Where you need depth
  
• Several years of professional C# and .NET development, with production code you can describe
  
and defend.
  
• Strong relational database skills: schema design, query tuning, and correct transaction and error
  
handling by reflex. PostgreSQL experience strongly preferred.
  
• Demonstrated ability to work out what unfamiliar code does, including code written in a
  
language or platform you have not used before, and a repeatable method for doing it safely.
  
• Agentic coding is table stakes. Deep, hands-on fluency with agentic tools (Claude Code, GitHub
  
Copilot, Cursor, or similar) as your primary way of working on real production code, from day
  
one, with the judgment to treat what they produce as work to be checked rather than answers
  
to be shipped.
  
Where working knowledge is enough
  
• Front end: a modern web framework, React with TypeScript preferred.
  
• Cloud: AWS (Azure considered), infrastructure as code, networking, managed databases, and
  
containers.
  
• Delivery: CI/CD with automated testing and zero-downtime deployment, plus production
  
monitoring and alerting.
  
Across everything
  
• Git and GitHub, with trunk-based development and short-lived branches.
  
• Comfort owning quality on a system that cannot fail quietly: disciplined testing, observability,
  
and careful, staged rollout.
  
• Clear written and spoken English, because much of your working contact with the team is
  
written.
  
• Availability to work hours that overlap the first half of the US Eastern working day, so you work
  
with your counterparts rather than around them.
  
Nice to have

• Experience in financial services or another regulated, high-stakes domain. Trust accounting,
  
wealth management, or fiduciary services is a strong plus but is not required. We will teach the
  
domain to the right engineer.
  
• Experience modernizing an established business application onto a cloud-native stack.
  
• AWS certification or equivalent depth in security, identity, and cost management on AWS.
  
• Building software under SOC 1 / SOC 2 or comparable regulated-environment controls.

title: Staff Software Development Engineer - DevOps
description:
**Job Summary**
:

We’re looking for a Staff Software Development Engineer to join our Developer Productivity & Platforms group. This role blends traffic engineering (API gateway, CDN, service-to-service routing) with core responsibilities, including automation, observability, reliability engineering, CI/CD workflows, and internal tooling that accelerates developer efficiency.

You’ll own critical systems responsible for managing API traffic — both north-south (external ingress) and east-west (internal service-to-service communication) — across a global, multi-cloud environment. You’ll architect resilient routing systems, edge integrations with CDNs, and observability hooks that ensure everything you build is secure, debuggable, and automated. Deep understanding of API Gateways like Envoy is a must.

This is a hands-on role with high visibility and impact. You’ll work across platform, SRE, and developer experience teams to ensure the infrastructure is reliable, observable, and developer-friendly — from traffic routing to deployments to production operations.

One of your key responsibilities will also be to design and build a unified traffic abstraction layer — a foundational platform that maps backend services deployed across various compute environments to their respective configurations on CDNs (e.g., Akamai, Fastly). This framework will centralize control over routing, metadata inventory, configuration tracking, and automated failover across CDNs. This capability does not currently exist and will be built from the ground up.

**About the team**
:

We are the Platform & Infrastructure Engineering group at JioHotstar, the architects behind one of the planet's most high-traffic streaming ecosystems. Our infrastructure recently powered a world-record 72.5 million concurrent viewers on a single live stream, and we proudly operated nine of the ten largest streaming events ever recorded. We empower hundreds of million users with seamless access to sports and entertainment through multi-region cloud orchestration and massive CDN automation. Our engineers tackle unprecedented challenges in real-time traffic management and edge computing under extreme demand—solving problems that define the industry standard for scale, cost-efficiency, and operational excellence.

Our group is defined by a strong bias for experimentation and the agility to navigate rapidly shifting priorities. We foster deep cross-functional collaboration, prioritize deployment velocity, rapid recovery, and developer enablement, allowing product teams to ship at speed without sacrificing system integrity. This is a high-visibility environment where decisions happen in seconds and engineering solutions become global case studies. If you are driven by high-impact work that brings historic moments to life for hundreds of millions, this is where you belong.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Own the technical vision and long-term evolution of the API Gateway and traffic platform supporting both north-south (external ingress) and east-west (internal service-to-service) traffic, operating at scale across a multi-cloud environment.
* Architect and drive a unified traffic abstraction layer that decouples backend services from CDN-specific implementations (Akamai, Fastly, Cloudflare), enabling centralized policy control, metadata-driven routing, automated multi-CDN failover, and future extensibility.
* Set architectural standards and design patterns for ingress, traffic routing, and API management, influencing multiple teams and ensuring consistency, security, scalability, and reliability across the organization.
* Lead complex, cross-team initiatives spanning networking, platform, SRE, security, and observability teams to deliver resilient, cloud-agnostic ingress solutions that account for varying network topologies, latency characteristics, and failure modes.
* Design and govern CI/CD and GitOps workflows for critical traffic infrastructure, defining best practices for safe deployments, progressive rollouts, automated validation, and rollback strategies across environments.
* Drive infrastructure-as-code maturity using Terraform, Helm, and Kubernetes, establishing reusable modules, golden paths, and guardrails that enable teams to deploy and operate traffic components safely and independently.
* Build and evolve foundational tooling and services (primarily in Go or Python) that improve visibility, control, scalability, and operational efficiency of API traffic systems at scale.
* Define observability strategy and standards for ingress and internal traffic systems, including metrics, logs, tracing, and SLOs; partner closely with observability and SRE teams to ensure systems are diagnosable and production-ready by default.
* Act as a technical multiplier by mentoring senior engineers, reviewing high-impact designs, unblocking teams, and raising the overall quality bar for platform engineering and distributed systems practices.
* Anticipate future needs and risks, proactively identifying scaling limits, security gaps, and reliability concerns, and driving strategic investments before they become production issues.

**Skills & Attributes for success:**

* Deep, hands-on experience with Envoy API Gateway platform in large-scale production environments, including ownership of architecture, rollout strategies, failure handling, and long-term evolution of ingress and traffic management systems.
* Expert-level programming capability in Go or Python, with a track record of designing and delivering production-grade platforms, internal tooling, and services that operate reliably at scale; able to make pragmatic trade-offs between performance, maintainability, and velocity.
* Good understanding of CDN architectures and integrations (Akamai, Fastly, Cloudflare or similar), including cache strategies, request routing, edge security, failover mechanisms, and best practices for high-availability API delivery across regions and providers.
* Advanced proficiency with infrastructure-as-code and container orchestration, leveraging Terraform, Kubernetes, and Helm to design reusable modules, define platform standards, and enable self-service while maintaining strong operational and security guardrails.
* Deep knowledge of networking and distributed systems fundamentals, including TLS termination, L4/L7 routing, traffic shaping, rate limiting, retries, circuit breaking, and failure isolation, with the ability to reason about system behavior under load and partial failure.
* Proven ability to design systems with observability, automation, and resiliency as first-class concerns, defining metrics, logs, traces, SLIs/SLOs, and automated remediation strategies in partnership with SRE and observability teams.
* Strong architectural judgment and systems thinking, able to navigate ambiguity, evaluate multiple solution paths, and influence technical decisions across teams through design reviews and technical leadership.
* Demonstrated ability to operate as a technical multiplier, mentoring senior engineers, raising engineering standards, and helping teams ship safer, faster, and more reliable systems.

**Preferred Education & Experience:**

* B-Tech or M-Tech in Computer Science or a related technical discipline from a reputed university.
* 9+ years of experience in Infrastructure, DevOps, or SRE roles focused on production traffic, automation and API delivery.

ML and LLM-powered applications on Azure, with real accountability for what happens after go-live: accuracy, cost, latency, safety, drift, and uptime.

**Responsibilities**
**What You'll Do**

* Own end-to-end deployment of AI applications on Azure — from classical ML models and Azure OpenAI Service integrations through to production release, monitoring, and iteration.
* Build and evaluate core ML models where GenAI isn't the right tool — classification, regression, forecasting, clustering, or recommendation problems using traditional ML techniques.
* Design and implement guardrails — content filtering, prompt injection defence, PII redaction, output validation, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints for high-risk actions.
* Build and maintain MLOps/LLMOps pipelines — CI/CD for models and prompts, feature engineering and data pipelines, automated evaluation harnesses, versioning for models/prompts/embeddings/fine-tunes, and rollback mechanisms.
* Manage the model lifecycle — model selection and routing (classical ML vs. smaller LLMs vs. frontier models by task complexity and cost), performance benchmarking, cost-per-call/cost-per-inference tracking, and deprecation/upgrade planning.
* Implement observability — logging, tracing, and alerting for LLM applications (token usage, latency, hallucination/error rates, user feedback loops).
* Architect RAG and agentic systems — vector store design, retrieval tuning, orchestration frameworks (LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, or equivalent), and multi-agent workflows where applicable.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with product owners, architects, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into scoped, deployable AI features.
* Contribute to AI governance — support responsible AI reviews, model risk assessments, and documentation required for enterprise sign-off.

**Qualifications**
**What You Bring**
**Must-Have**

* Minimum of 3–4 years of hands-on software/ML engineering experience, with at least 2 years specifically on GenAI/LLM applications taken to production.
* Solid grounding in core AI/ML fundamentals — supervised/unsupervised learning, model evaluation metrics, feature engineering, handling class imbalance/overfitting, and knowing when a classical ML model beats an LLM for the job.

A hands-on camera engineering expert who can independently bring up both YUV422 and RAW cameras, troubleshoot complex hardware/software integration issues, and help advance automotive camera platform development.

**We are Siemens**
Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many different industries. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many of the objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and manufactured using our software.
  
  
Our Shared Engineering Services team is at the forefront of validating and releasing the cutting-edge Simcenter™ portfolio. In this role, you will combine your knowledge of CAE, physics-based simulation, Engineering AI, and software quality to validate AI/ML models and their integration into desktop simulation products. description:
The Calix platform enables Communication Service Providers (CSPs) of all sizes to transform and future-proof their businesses. Our Enterprise Platform team aspires to be a leader by applying technology to power business strategies. We connect concepts with solutions to create value and efficiencies for our employees and customers. Our success is driven by our skilled and diverse team who are passionate about excellence, innovation, and agility.
  
  
As the Senior Salesforce Test Automation Engineer, you will lead the expansion of automated quality engineering across our Salesforce ecosystem, with primary ownership for establishing Cypress.io as a scalable, maintainable, and trusted enterprise test automation capability. You will combine hands-on automation engineering with technical leadership, partnering with developers, administrators, product owners, business analysts, release engineering, and quality engineers to improve release confidence, shorten feedback cycles, and reduce reliance on repetitive manual regression testing.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Lead the design, implementation, and ongoing evolution of a Cypress.io automation framework for Salesforce applications, Experience Cloud, integrated web applications, and critical end-to-end business processes.
* Define automation architecture, coding standards, repository structure, reusable commands, fixtures, test-data patterns, environment configuration, tagging, and reporting conventions that support maintainability and scale.
* Develop and maintain reliable automated suites for smoke, regression, integration, end-to-end, API, and selected component-testing scenarios, balancing UI coverage with faster API-based setup and validation where appropriate.
* Create a pragmatic automation roadmap that prioritizes high-risk, high-volume, and business-critical Salesforce journeys and converts the existing regression inventory into a sustainable Cypress test portfolio.
* Design resilient approaches for Salesforce-specific automation challenges, including dynamic Lightning DOM behavior, asynchronous processing, authentication, role-based access, complex data dependencies, integrations, and multi-environment execution.
* Integrate Cypress execution into CI/CD pipelines and release workflows, including pull-request validation, scheduled regression runs, pre-release quality gates, test result publishing, screenshots, videos, and failure diagnostics.
* Establish test observability and quality metrics such as automation coverage, pass rate, execution time, flaky-test rate, defect escape trends, failure causes, and manual effort avoided; use insights to drive continuous improvement.
* Build secure, repeatable test-data and credential-management practices across Salesforce sandboxes and connected systems, partnering with platform, security, and DevOps teams to protect sensitive information.
* Perform hands-on exploratory, functional, integration, regression, and release-readiness testing when automation is not yet available or when human judgment provides better coverage.
* Partner with product owners, business analysts, solution architects, developers, and administrators to make requirements testable and to strengthen acceptance criteria, negative scenarios, risk analysis, and definition-of-done standards.
* Troubleshoot failed tests and application defects, distinguish product issues from automation issues, document reproducible evidence, and collaborate with engineering teams through resolution.
* Review automation code, mentor quality engineers and developers, provide technical guidance, and promote engineering practices that treat automated tests as production-quality software.
* Evaluate Cypress.io capabilities, plugins, Cypress Cloud features, and AI-assisted test authoring; recommend adoption based on security, maintainability, cost, measurable value, and enterprise standards.
* Contribute to QA governance, release management, Agile ceremonies, test planning, risk reviews, and continuous improvement across the software development lifecycle.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 7+ years of software quality engineering and test automation experience, including 3+ years testing Salesforce solutions in complex enterprise environments.
* Advanced hands-on experience building and maintaining Cypress.io automation using JavaScript or TypeScript, with strong understanding of selectors, custom commands, fixtures, network interception, retries, asynchronous behavior, and test isolation.
* Demonstrated experience designing an automation framework or materially scaling an existing framework across teams, applications, or release trains.
* Strong Salesforce testing experience across Lightning Experience and one or more of Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, CPQ/commerce, custom Apex and Lightning Web Components, integrations, or platform automation.
* Experience with API testing, including REST and GraphQL patterns, authentication, request/response validation, data setup, and combining API and UI tests.
* Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and source-control workflows using tools such as GitHub or Bitbucket and pipeline technologies such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or equivalent.
* Experience with test management, defect lifecycle, and work-management tools such as Jira, Xray, Confluence, or equivalent.
* Experience developing quality strategies, risk-based test plans, automation backlogs, traceability, release-readiness assessments, and meaningful quality reporting in Agile/Scrum environments.
* Experience diagnosing flaky tests, improving suite performance, handling parallel execution, and maintaining reliable automation across multiple environments and data states.

**Skills:**

* Expert-level analytical and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to isolate failures across the UI, Salesforce platform, APIs, integrations, test data, and automation framework.
* Strong software engineering fundamentals, including modular design, version control, code review, debugging, documentation, and maintainable test-code practices.
* Ability to translate business processes and technical architecture into clear, risk-based automated test coverage.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain quality risks, trade-offs, and recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Demonstrated leadership through influence, mentorship, collaboration, and ownership of cross-team outcomes.
* Ability to work independently, navigate ambiguity, prioritize effectively, and balance immediate release needs with long-term automation health.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Salesforce Administrator, Platform App Builder, Platform Developer I, or relevant Salesforce Consultant certification.
* Cypress certification, recognized test automation certification, or equivalent evidence of deep Cypress expertise.
* Experience with Cypress Cloud capabilities such as recorded runs, test replay, analytics, flaky-test insights, parallelization, and enterprise reporting.
* Experience with Okta or SSO-enabled test authentication and secure automated credential management.
* Familiarity with accessibility testing, performance testing, AI-assisted test generation, and complementary tools such as Postman, SoapUI, Selenium, Playwright, or Jest.
* Experience modernizing or migrating an automation portfolio from a commercial or legacy testing platform to Cypress.io.

**What Success Looks Like:**

* Cypress.io is established as a governed, secure, and reusable automation capability for Salesforce delivery.
* Critical business journeys have reliable automated coverage and provide fast, actionable feedback before releases.
* CI/CD pipelines consistently execute the right tests at the right stage, with clear evidence for failures and release decisions.
* Flaky tests, duplicated effort, and manual regression time decline as framework quality, test data, and team adoption improve.
* Developers and quality engineers contribute to a shared automation codebase using consistent standards and effective code reviews.
* Quality metrics clearly communicate risk, progress, and business value to engineering and leadership stakeholders.

**Why Join Us**
?
  
  

* Shape the test automation strategy for a business-critical Salesforce platform and influence quality engineering practices across teams.
* Lead a high-visibility Cypress.io implementation with opportunities to modernize delivery, improve engineering velocity, and reduce release risk.
* Work with a collaborative, forward-thinking team investing in Salesforce, AI-enabled engineering, and enterprise platform transformation.
* Access ongoing professional development, technical learning, and Salesforce certification opportunities.
* Competitive compensation and benefits.

**Location:**

* India – (Flexible hybrid work model - work from Bangalore office for 20 days in a quarter)

description:

More about
**our mission**
and
**what we offer**
.
  
  
**Purpose**
Establish and own the analytics and technical reporting capability within Core Compliance. This senior individual contributor combines analytics engineering depth with the judgement to set direction, translate complex Compliance processes into dependable data products, and drive delivery across organisational boundaries.
  
  
The role adds dedicated technical expertise and hands-on delivery capacity to extend what Group Compliance can monitor, analyse and report.
  
  
Working closely with the CCSDE Lead and other relevant leads, this person will establish the Core Compliance analytics repository and delivery approach in line with wider Wise analytics best practices. They will own implementation for Core Compliance systems and tools where capability or capacity gaps exist, and lead the coordination of changes that require delivery by established analytics or Engineering teams.
  
  
**Scope**
The role owns the technical quality and delivery of the analytics assets established within its agreed Core Compliance remit. Other analytics and Engineering teams retain their existing responsibilities for shared platforms, datasets and wider analytics delivery. Changes to those capabilities are agreed and implemented with their owners.
  
  
Existing analytics teams retain their request-collection processes. This role works within Group Compliance to identify and deliver capability improvements and provide senior technical engagement on analytics issues.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Own the technical foundations for Core Compliance analytics
  
  

* Design and establish the Core Compliance repository and analytics delivery setup, working with Engineering and analytics partners on the use of dbt, Airflow, Snowflake and Lightdash within the existing Wise environment.
* Make and document design decisions for models, transformations, orchestration and reporting: source selection, data grain, keys, historical changes, refresh dependencies and recovery behaviour.
* Establish GitHub development and review practices, automated checks, release procedures, access arrangements and documentation aligned with wider standards. Ensure the setup can support multiple use cases and be maintained by others.
* Agree the interfaces, dependencies and support responsibilities with the teams that own shared infrastructure and upstream datasets.

Deliver and operate models pipelines and reporting
  
  

* Write SQL and dbt models, implement workflow orchestration in Airflow, and build reporting in Lightdash on Snowflake for systems and tools within the Core Compliance remit.
* Take work through discovery, design, implementation, validation, release and ongoing improvement. Exercise technical judgement on when to reuse an existing capability, extend a local model or coordinate an upstream change.
* Address practical engineering concerns such as incremental processing, historical accuracy, duplicate or late data, safe reprocessing and query performance where they affect the use case.
* Define and implement checks for completeness, accuracy, freshness and reconciliation, together with actionable failure notifications and documented recovery procedures for the components owned by Core Compliance.
* Investigate issues through the data flow, resolve defects within the role's ownership and work with upstream owners on source or platform issues.

Develop trusted metrics and actionable analysis
  
  

* Create ad hoc analysis, reports, dashboards and metrics across CCSDE and CMT, connecting the output to the monitoring, oversight or operational decision it needs to support.
* Translate process concepts such as reporting deadlines, ownership, workflow status, ageing and completion into explicit metric definitions and data models. Account for exceptions and changes over time.
* Validate analytical results against source records, explain material limitations and ensure that colleagues can understand and use the outputs with confidence.
* Establish reusable definitions and reporting assets where needs recur, with documented lineage, ownership and quality expectations. Retain the ability to answer new questions quickly through focused analysis.

Set priorities and lead delivery across teams
  
  

* Identify the most valuable gaps in Core Compliance's monitoring and reporting capability and develop a prioritised delivery roadmap with the relevant leads.
* Act as the principal Core Compliance contact on analytics issues, bringing the technical understanding needed to establish scope, resolve unclear ownership and agree implementation approaches with partner teams.
* Drive dependencies and cross-team decisions through to delivery. Make trade-offs between immediate analytical needs, maintainability and partner capacity, and communicate their implications clearly.
* Coordinate updates and implementations owned by other teams while remaining accountable for defining the Core Compliance need and validating that the resulting capability meets it.

Apply AI and agentic workflows with technical judgement
  
  

* Use approved AI tools and agent harnesses in analytics and development workflows, including SQL and dbt development, test generation, documentation, data investigation and review.
* Develop useful GitHub-based working practices and agentic workflows that improve delivery speed and consistency, with clear review, testing and access boundaries.
* Evaluate generated code and analytical outputs against source data and expected behaviour. Assess the practical benefit of these workflows and share effective approaches with colleagues.

**Qualifications**
**What you will bring**

* Advanced SQL and strong data-modelling skills, with evidence of personally delivering reliable analytical models, pipelines and reporting used in operational decisions.
* Substantial hands-on experience with dbt or equivalent transformation frameworks, orchestration such as Airflow, and a cloud data warehouse such as Snowflake. Ability to work effectively across the target stack, including Lightdash.
* Experience establishing or materially improving an analytics repository and delivery process, including GitHub collaboration, testing, review, deployment and documentation.
* Technical depth in data quality, troubleshooting and performance, with the ability to explain design choices and their consequences rather than relying on tool familiarity alone.
* A track record of taking ambiguous business problems through to implementation, setting priorities and influencing technical and non-technical stakeholders without relying on reporting-line authority.
* Strong analytical judgement: defining meaningful metrics, validating evidence and communicating findings and limitations clearly.
* Applied knowledge of AI-assisted analytics, agent harnesses and agentic development workflows, including how to verify outputs and use them responsibly in a collaborative environment.

**Bonus Experience**
Experience with Core Compliance, monitoring and testing, regulatory reporting workflows, or incident and breach management. Familiarity with data products that support controls, evidence, retention and access requirements is valuable. Financial Crime experience is an additional benefit where relevant to the work.
  
  
Additional Information
  
  
**What Success Looks Like**

* Critical data products have clear owners, documented definitions and measurable reliability expectations.
* An agreed technical design, Core Compliance repository and working development process aligned with wider Wise analytics best practices, with clear ownership and partner interfaces.
* An initial priority pipeline or model operating reliably, supported by tests, documentation, failure handling and an agreed maintenance approach.
* A set of trusted reports, dashboards and metrics addressing material needs across CCSDE and CMT, with definitions validated by the relevant users.
* A prioritised roadmap and effective delivery arrangements with partner teams, demonstrating increased monitoring and reporting capability within Core Compliance.

We dive deep into data to extract the greatest value and discover opportunities in key business and functions like Banking, Insurance, Manufacturing, Healthcare, Retail, Manufacturing and Auto, Supply Chain, and Finance.

We’re looking for Senior Manager (AI Architects) with strong technology and data understanding having proven pre-sales & delivery capability. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading consulting firm as well as a part of growing consulting practise.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Business Value Engineering & Consultative Selling**

* Partner with C‑suite and senior business leaders to understand strategic priorities and identify AI-led transformation opportunities that deliver clear business value.
* Shape, articulate, build future architecture, and present compelling value propositions, solution narratives, and business cases for AI/GenAI/Agentic AI engagements.
* Domain experience from Consumer &Retail , Telecom / Media, Manufacturing & Industrial sectors, Oil & Gas
* Drive account teams in pursuit cycles, contributing to RFP responses, solution design, storyline decks, and client presentations.
* Lead client discovery and ideation workshops to define AI use cases, roadmap, and ROI frameworks.
* Drive consultative selling by helping clients understand where AI can meaningfully impact operations, customer experience, finance, and industry‑specific value chains.

**AI Architecture, Design & Solutioning**

* Architect end‑to‑end AI, Generative AI, and Agentic AI solutions across Azure (Azure AI, Azure OpenAI), AWS (SageMaker), and GCP (Vertex AI).
* Leverage leading AI platforms such as OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Hugging Face, LangChain, vector databases (Pinecone, ChromaDB), and agent orchestration frameworks.
* Design architecture patterns for enterprise AI systems—including RAG, autonomous agent workflows, LLMOps, and scalable cloud-native deployments.
* Work with data engineering and data science teams to define data models, pipelines, and ML development workflows using Databricks, Synapse, Snowflake, Spark, Kubernetes, Docker, etc.

**Delivery Oversight & Technical Leadership**

* Oversee delivery of AI/GenAI projects to ensure architecture integrity, engineering quality, and alignment to business value commitments.
* Act as the technical escalation point during delivery, guiding solution teams and ensuring adherence to best practices.
* Review detailed solution designs, code, and architectural artifacts to maintain technical rigor.
* Mentor and coach architects, AI engineers, and delivery teams on solution design, coding standards, and engineering excellence.

**Innovation, Prototyping & Thought Leadership**

* Drive the development of POVs, accelerators, prototypes, and demos using Azure AI, OpenAI, NVIDIA AI, and related technologies.
* Create industry-specific and horizontal reference architectures, reusable assets, and solution frameworks.
* Represent the practice in client discussions, internal leadership forums, and external industry events on AI strategy and innovation.

**Engineering & Build (Selective / Hands-on as Needed)**

* Lead by example with hands‑on prototyping when required; write and review high-quality, testable code in Python and other languages.
* Guide teams in adopting modern practices for MLOps/LLMOps, DevOps, observability, and secure deployment.

**To Qualify for the Role, You Must Have**

* Extensive pre‑sales and consultative experience with the ability to diagnose business problems, frame value propositions, and connect AI capabilities to measurable business impact.
* 16+ years of professional experience, including 5–8 years architecting and deploying enterprise‑scale AI/ML, GenAI, and Agentic AI solutions on cloud or on‑prem environments.
* Experience in working & managing global stakeholders.
* Should have driven significant business outcomes as a part of their role.
* Strong RFP/RFI leadership experience, including solution shaping, writing technical sections, and conducting client-facing architecture and value engineering workshops.
* Deep expertise in designing AI solutions using microservices and cloud-native architectures, with strong understanding of Agentic AI, AI-ready data, and enterprise-scale LLM solution patterns (RAG, agents, orchestration).
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Proven experience defining MLOps, LLMOps, and AgentOps architectures, including model lifecycle automation, observability, governance, and responsible AI.
* Hands-on experience deploying AI/ML solutions on Azure, AWS, and/or GCP, with strong understanding of platform-native services (Azure AI, Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, GCP Vertex/Gemini).
* Strong experience using and orchestrating LLMs across cloud platforms—OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Bedrock, Vertex AI, Gemini AI, vector DBs, and agent frameworks.
* Solid background in data modeling, SQL, and modern data architectures (Databricks, Snowflake, Synapse).
* Strong foundational understanding of machine learning, deep learning, NLP, and Generative AI.
* Advanced programming skills in Python (and optionally PySpark) for prototyping, validation, and reference implementations.
* Experience integrating enterprise‑grade security, identity, and authentication into AI/ML and LLM-based applications.
* Proven expertise deploying AI/ML workloads on Kubernetes, Web Apps, Databricks, or similar cloud-native platforms.
* Strong working knowledge of MLOps / LLMOps / AgentOps toolchains—Git, MLflow, feature stores, CI/CD, batch inference, real-time endpoints.
* Familiarity with Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, and related DevOps tooling.
* Working knowledge of Responsible AI principles, governance, model risk management, and compliance.
* Demonstrated experience delivering enterprise-grade, production-ready architectures and guiding delivery teams through implementation.
* Strong understanding of data strategy, cloud-native engineering, analytics modernization, and platform-driven transformation.

**Ideally, You’ll Also Have**

* Project and client management skills.
* Experience in solutioning and pre-sales engagements.
* Exposure to data mesh principles and domain-oriented data product design.
* Familiarity with data fabric architectures and multi-cloud data strategies.
* Familiarity with real-time analytics

**What We Look For**

* People with technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
